description:
*“You can’t run away. I’m going to eat you up from now on.”* 

That night when I witnessed my sister and my boyfriend’s inappropriate relationship, it was just an impulsive one-night stand I chose to soothe my troubled heart…

 *“I’m Managing Director Kang In-Ha.”*

We’re going to meet again as the boss I have to serve from now on. But this man… Doesn’t he remember me? He seems to be used to one-night stands, so I try to control my emotions as he acts calm, but his eyes, his lips, his gestures keep bringing back memories of that day. 

*“I wondered why she provokes me every time I see her, but it turns out she’s already a woman I’ve fallen for.”*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
